messages:
sara_sales: Emerald Health requested a performance POC. Requirements: sustained 75 qps for 1h, avg response ~8k tokens, p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms. They also want HIPAA/BAA, customer KMS, and a pricing comparison (hosted vs dedicated).

alex_runtime: Important: model choice (7B quant vs fp16) will change GPU count and latency. Recommend testing rwd-7b-quant and rwd-7b-fp16.

lucy_se: Proposed test plan: smoke (10m), 1hr soak (75 qps) with 10m ramp and 10m cooldown, plus a couple short spikes to validate autoscale. Run 2k-token demo first, then a single 1hr 8k-token capped soak if they approve Dedicated/Private.

mike_infra: Infra note: 8k tokens sustained probably needs multiple GPUs (estimate 3-4) depending on batching. Dedicated with CMK requires IAM setup and cross-account role 1-3 business days for validation. Private needed for zero public egress.

ryan_ae: Buyer wants the "delta" in cost. Can we get a quick estimate for the POC?

alex_runtime: Rough calc: tokens = 75 qps * 3600s * 8000 tokens = ~2.16B tokens. Hosted per-token example (rwd-7b-quant) @ $0.03 / 1k tokens => ~ $64.8k for that hour. Dedicated amortized cost for similar throughput likely in the low thousands for the hour (~$6k-$12k) since infra commit amortizes. Will provide exacts after run.

lucy_se: Recommend offering the demo at 2k avg so they can validate latency without incurring huge hosted costs. Also demonstrate prefix caching and batching savings.

sara_sales: Emerald said 8k is a peak but wants proof. We'll propose: 2k demo next Tue 14:00 PT, and a capped 1hr 8k soak on Dedicated/Private if they greenlight infra+KMS.

alex_runtime: I'll prepare the load script (vegeta curl-based). Will post p50/p95/p99, GPU util, batch stats after runs.

mike_infra: KMS checklist for customer: 1) share CMK ARN + cross-account role, 2) apply policy, 3) test encrypt/decrypt in staging. ETA 2-3 business days. Also note: Hosted cannot satisfy zero egress requirement.

lucy_se: Security/Compliance: I'll attach HIPAA summary and SOC2 statement to the customer. They also asked for HITRUST items; will follow up.

deploy-bot: scheduled: rwd-7b-quant -> staging at 2025-12-03T14:00:00Z by alex_runtime. CI checks passed.

ryan_ae: I'll prepare a slide with three scenarios: quick hosted demo (2k), hosted full (per-token cost), and dedicated reserved (commit math). Need precise token counts post-run.

sara_sales: Action items: Lucy run smoke + 2k soak Tue; Alex run 8k capped soak when infra ready; Mike do KMS/VPC prep; Ryan assemble pricing slide. I'll message Emerald with the two-step plan and copy eng.

alex_runtime: After tests I'll post results (latency percentiles, token breakdown, GPU counts, and tuning notes for batch/KV cache).

lucy_se: Smoke (2k) completed on staging: p95 ~225ms, p99 ~490ms, avg tokens ~2.05k. Logs uploaded to CI.

sara_sales: Thanks all 1 will send the customer message and track KMS blocker. :thumbsup:
